annotation.verification_order: Fixed-seed shuffle of all 50 creation-pass cases.
annotation.procedure: The verification pass reopened cited SQLite chunks, page ranges, paper metadata, and direct corpus inventory in fixed-seed shuffled order. It rechecked question phrasing, category, relevant-paper set, evidence support, answerability, distractors, uncertainty, and split. Retrieval functions, search endpoints, result rankings, and system scores were not inspected while labeling or verifying.
annotation.remaining_uncertainty: Six cases remain medium uncertainty because broad-intent or multi-paper set completeness is less determinate than exact factual lookup; no case is marked high uncertainty.

annotation_consistency.metric_label: AI two-pass annotation consistency; not human inter-rater reliability
annotation_consistency.definition: For each case, the candidate universe is the union of papers explicitly judged relevant or hard-negative in either pass. A paper newly added as relevant during verification is treated as nonrelevant in the creation pass. The binary relevant/nonrelevant labels are compared across those 70 candidate judgments. This measures one AI review process's two-pass consistency and must not be reported as independent human agreement.

unanswerable_verification.method: Expanded direct title and chunk-text checks were run for each requested absent domain. Incidental bibliography/reference terms were not treated as a relevant study.
unanswerable_verification.result: All four out-of-corpus cases remained unanswerable from the indexed papers.

redistribution_note: The JSONL stores identifiers, page ranges, and paraphrased evidence summaries; it does not embed paper PDFs or full chunk text.
